'''Steelton''' was a company operating during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It produced the strong [[control cable]]s used to connect a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] cockpit to the vehicle's turbine engines. While smaller companies produced similar cables, Steelton dominated the market.<ref name="EV" />
